title: —Your beloved is here
html_source:
Oh…

Stephen is proudly running through his theories on aesthetics and is surprised by seeing “[his] beloved”. This stops him immediately—an entirely apparent shift from philosophical thoughts to more base dialogue and Stephen simply observing things. It appears that Stephen hasn’t achieved a great deal of comfort in such a situation as this, as he essentially quiets and just observes—"His mind emptied of theory and courage, lapsed back into a listless peace."
